The question can be read two ways. I took it as the probability that a randomly chosen female likes In-N-Out best, which is the share of females who chose it. That is 181 of the 252 females, or about 0.72.

The other reading is the share of all 500 respondents who are female and chose In-N-Out. I didn't compute that one.

ANSWER: 0.72
